newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro eyes SHV Holdings cash and carry unit.
newsitem.headline: Metro eyes SHV Holdings cash and carry unit.

text.p: Retail group Metro AG and its majority shareholder Metro Holding AG said on Monday they are in talks with the Dutch retailer SHV Holdings NV about taking over its cash and carry business, the Utrecht-based Makro.
"The negotiations are to be concluded as soon as possible," Metro said in a statement.
The talks concern two sets of businesses.

The first is Makro's 86 cash and carry outlets in Britain, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Greece, the Czech Republic and Morocco with sales expected to reach 16 billion marks this year. Metro Holding already owns 40 percent of these businesses.

The second area concerns companies in which SHV and Makro own minority stakes in cash and carry businesses owned by Metro Holding in Denmark, Austria, Italy, France, Hungary and Turkey with sales this year expected to reach 13.6 billion marks.
